name: navi-recap
description: Turn git commit history into a product-evolution story and a polished single-file HTML slide deck: mine commits across sibling repos, verify flows in code before drawing them, narrate for non-engineers, then build and visually verify the deck.
author: Norman

interface.shortDescription: Git history → product story → HTML slide deck.
interface.longDescription: Summarize a window of git commits (Navi + engineering-agent-registry by default, any repo works) into a non-engineer-friendly product-evolution story, with code-verified flow descriptions, and optionally render it as a single-file HTML slide deck with built-in macOS rendering verification.
